description: Spec §7.1: a BP_DFFxExplosion starts with its first shell at base x StartScale and Fade 1 (BeginPlay applies the t = 0 look); 0.6 s later (about 0.66 s headless) that shell's relative scale X is greater than its base x StartScale (and not past base x EndScale), its MID's Fade is below 0.9, and that MID is the shell's material.
